response: Yes, the processing of affective prosody is influenced by spatial attention. Research has shown that spatial attention can modulate the processing of emotional cues in speech, including affective prosody, which refers to the emotional tone of voice. When attention is directed to a specific location or speaker, the processing of affective prosody is enhanced, allowing for better recognition and interpretation of emotional information. Conversely, when attention is diverted or divided, the processing of affective prosody can be impaired. This suggests that spatial attention plays a significant role in shaping our perception and interpretation of emotional speech.
